scope: Still-image expansion, hover geometry, image-control defaults and fixed presentation instructions from a permitted released public client. The pinned client is executed only through bounded synthetic VM stubs; no public posts or media are inputs.

imageExpansion.label: Image expansion
imageExpansion.tip: Enable inline image expansion, limited to browser width

fitToScreenExpansion.label: Fit expanded images to screen
fitToScreenExpansion.tip: Limit expanded images to both browser width and height

imageHover.label: Image hover
imageHover.tip: Mouse over images to view full size, limited to browser size

imageHoverBg.label: Set a background color for transparent images

revealSpoilers.label: Don't spoiler images
revealSpoilers.tip: Show image thumbnail and original filename instead of spoiler placeholders

geometry.expansion_height: Natural height unless fitToScreenExpansion is true, then documentElement.clientHeight.
geometry.hover_height: The load-start handler limits width; fixed #image-hover CSS supplies max-height: 100% of the viewport.

spoiler_filename.hidden_original_carrier: The unrevealed file-text element keeps the original filename in its title metadata.
spoiler_filename.revealed_behavior: Reveal restores the original filename in the file-text link while replacing the spoiler placeholder thumbnail with the real thumbnail.

rewrite_boundaries: The rewrite accepts only approved normalized PNG routes from its configured media origin. The public client can expand other still-image formats and has separate WebM/MP4 handling; its PDF match bypasses the still-image expansion branch.
The rewrite caps decoded image dimensions at 1024, simultaneous expansions at eight and an individual load at ten seconds. These are finite local safety bounds, not v1191 defaults.
The rewrite keeps one hover image and uses the fixed page module without upstream runtime imports or new network authority.

The public client inherits an opaque body background for transparent-image previews. Rewrite themes place the paper color on the document root and keep the body transparent, so preview CSS uses --paper to retain the visible page color.

The source expansion width uses documentElement.clientWidth, while source hover width uses window.innerWidth. A rewrite using clientWidth for hover can be narrower when a classic scrollbar consumes layout width.
